privacy.heading: Your data
privacy.title: Yuzora collects no data
privacy.about: Nothing about you, your terminals, files or projects leaves this computer for Yuzora or for Herdr.
privacy.usage_about: Herdr's daily usage report is switched off in Yuzora, whatever settings.json or the environment say.
privacy.feedback_about: Send feedback opens a GitHub issue in your browser; you read it and send it yourself.
privacy.network: Yuzora goes online only when you ask it to (a remote machine, a database, git) and every hour to look for updates: Yuzora's on GitHub Releases, herdr-core's from its own. Looking sends none of your files or usage.

updates.app_off: This Yuzora doesn't update itself (a build from source, for one): new versions come from GitHub Releases.
updates.footer: Yuzora (on GitHub Releases) and herdr-core are checked every hour; a newer one shows in the corner, and Yuzora's applies when it restarts. herdr-core runs your terminals, so they keep running through its updates.
